items.title: Lawrence Duhé Interview, 1957-06-09
items.q: First, now I played with Piron on the roof garden.

ctx.x: Now who did you play with in New Orleans first then?
First, now I played with Piron on the roof garden.
That big and high building is still there, isn't it? No, that's down. Oh, I thought the one by the city hall.

items.title: Lawrence Duhé Interview, 1960
items.q: I played in the Blue Room, Roosevelt Hotel with A.J. Piron.

ctx.x: Mr. Dewey, would you tell us the various place, places that your band played while you were in New Orleans?

Mr. Dewey, would you tell us the, uh, the band played? Among, among the, among the players, there's the 101 Wrench, uh, Pete Lawless Cabaret, and Nagel and Vor, Nagel and Hunt's Cabaret. There's three places right there, in the Storyville. Now, but I played at, uh, uh, Cardinal. Yeah, I played in the Blue Room, Roosevelt Hotel with A.J. Piron. I played at, uh, Racetrack. I played at Franchina. I played at, uh, West End. What about the Montelion? Montelion Hotel Blue Room. I also played, uh, that's right, go right…
Oh. Uh, Mr. Dewey, did you play in other places outside of New Orleans, Mississippi, etc.? Do you recall any places that you played? Yeah, with some, someone else. I was only hired.
